title: Garrison / Autonomy
description: Keepers: ticks by outcome and wake source, skipped and failed wakes, tick start lag, and the intervals the scheduler applies. Also messaging, executive proposals, and evaluation: eval runs, case durations, shadow comparisons, and canary transitions.

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Garrison node: the server pod or container name, or the worker node name.

panels.title: Ticks
panels.description: Keeper ticks finished or skipped in the selected range.

panels.title: Attention and escalations
panels.description: Ticks that ended Attention or Escalated in the selected range.

panels.title: Failed ticks
panels.description: Ticks that failed (the run failed, timed out, or could not start) in the selected range.

panels.title: Skipped wakes
panels.description: Timer wakes skipped because the previous tick was still running, in the selected range.

panels.title: Ticks by outcome
panels.description: Keeper ticks per second by outcome.

panels.title: Ticks by wake source
panels.description: Keeper ticks per second by why they woke (timer, manual, message, escalation answer).

panels.title: Tick start lag
panels.description: Time from a wake coming due to the scheduler starting its tick (p50, p95, p99). Rising lag means the sweep is behind: raise Autonomy.MaxDueClaimsPerSweep or lower Autonomy.SchedulerSweepSeconds.

panels.title: Scheduled interval
panels.description: Median interval scheduled after a tick, by wake mode. Backoff keepers that stay quiet drift toward their maximum.

panels.title: Escalations by outcome
panels.description: Escalations raised and resolved per second, by outcome (raised, answered, cancelled, withdrawn, expired, escalated).

panels.title: Time to answer
panels.description: Time from raising an escalation to its answer.

panels.title: Freezes by action
panels.description: Freeze actions per second, by action (applied, lifted, refused, skipped, cancelled): refused counts runs a freeze turned away and skipped counts keeper wakes it skipped.

panels.title: Spend cap hits
panels.description: Keeper spend caps reached per second, by scope (mandate_tick, mandate_day).

panels.title: Memory operations by outcome
panels.description: Scoped memory operations per second by operation and outcome. Conflicts are compare-and-set writes that lost to another writer; refused are policy or bound refusals.

panels.title: Memory operations by scope kind
panels.description: Scoped memory operations per second by scope kind (agent, app, orgunit, organization).

panels.title: Reports by health
panels.description: Reports filed per second by health (healthy, degraded, unhealthy, unknown).

panels.title: Reports by kind
panels.description: Reports filed per second by kind (status, incident, decision, handoff, brief).

panels.title: Messages by outcome
panels.description: Messages between agents per second by outcome (queued, rejected, delivered, acknowledged, expired, woke).

panels.title: Message delivery lag
panels.description: Time from send to delivery to a run of the recipient, by urgency: p50 and p95.

panels.title: Loop guard rejections
panels.description: Messages refused when sent, per second, by reason (hop_limit, line_rate, thread_budget, no_line, frozen).

panels.title: Org unit budgets exhausted
panels.description: Org unit budgets that replicas have seen exhausted in their current window, by period (day, month). Runs in those subtrees are refused with BudgetExhausted. No organization or unit identifiers.

panels.title: Org budget refusals
panels.description: Runs refused per second because an org unit spent its budget, by window (org_unit_day, org_unit_month).

panels.title: Executive proposals
panels.description: Executive drafts that asked to apply, by decision source (rule, user) and outcome (applied, waiting, denied, refused, failed). Rule-applied proposals are recorded as org revisions that rollback undoes. No organization, unit, or agent identifiers.

panels.title: Shadow comparisons
panels.description: Shadow trial comparisons by result: agreed, diverged, candidate failed, error.

panels.title: Canary transitions
panels.description: Canary release transitions: started, advanced, promoted, rolled back, aborted.

panels.title: Eval runs
panels.description: Eval runs finished, by outcome: passed, failed, completed, error, cancelled.

panels.title: Eval case duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time from an eval case's run start to its scored result, by scorer.

panels.title: Board directions
panels.description: Board directions published to an organization's top agent, by organization.

panels.title: Board briefs
panels.description: Reports of kind Brief filed for the board.

panels.title: Scheduled eval checks
panels.description: Scheduled checks fired by EvalSet triggers, by outcome: started when the eval run was created, failed when it could not start (for example, no recent inputs to replay).
